2 Days Lake Naivasha Lake Nakuru Safari

Package overview

This short but rewarding safari takes you to two of Kenya’s most scenic Rift Valley lakes— , famous for its freshwater ecosystem, birdlife, and optional boat rides; and , a renowned sanctuary for rhinos, tree-climbing lions, and a variety of bird species. Ideal for travelers seeking a quick yet immersive wildlife and nature experience close to Nairobi.

  • Lake Naivasha
  • Boat Safari: Cruise the freshwater lake for close encounters with hippos that bob on the surface and vast colonies of majestic birds, including African Fish Eagles.
  • Crescent Island Walking Safari: Enjoy a guided walk among grazing animals (giraffes, zebras, and various antelopes) in a safe, open environment—a unique highlight where you are on foot with the wildlife.
  • Great Rift Valley Views: The drive to Naivasha provides spectacular, sweeping views as you descend into the valley floor.
  • Lake Nakuru National Park
  • Rhino Sanctuary: Lake Nakuru National Park is Kenya's first government-protected rhino sanctuary and a major highlight. It hosts one of the largest concentrations of the critically endangered Eastern black rhino and a thriving population of Southern white rhino
  • Rare Rothschild's Giraffe: The park is a sanctuary for the endangered Rothschild's giraffe, which was translocated here for its protection.
  • The Big Five (minus one): The park is home to four of the "Big Five" game animals: lions, leopards, rhinos, and buffaloes. Elephants are not present due to the park's perimeter fencing.

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Nairobi - Lake Naivasha - Lake Nakuru

Depart Nairobi in the morning and drive through the Great Rift Valley viewpoint for stunning panoramas. Proceed to Lake Naivasha , a peaceful freshwater lake known for bird watching and sightings of hippos along the shores. Optional activities (extra cost): Boat ride on Lake Naivasha Visit Crescent Island for a walking safari among giraffes, zebras & antelopes After lunch, drive to Lake Nakuru National Park . Afternoon game drive where you may spot: White and black rhinos Rothschild giraffes Buffaloes, zebras, lions, and various bird species Dinner and overnight at your Lake Nakuru lodge/camp. Mid-range: Lake Nakuru Sopa Lodge, Flamingo Hill Camp Luxury: Sarova Lion Hill Lodge

02Day 2 | Lake Nakuru → Nairobi

Early morning game drive in Lake Nakuru National Park, exploring the acacia woodlands, shores, and open savannah. Look out for the park’s famous rhino sanctuary , tree-climbing lions, spotted hyenas, and diverse birdlife including pelicans and flamingos (seasonal). Exit the park and drive back to Nairobi. Drop-off at your preferred location, marking the end of your safari. Please note that this safari is fully customizable to suit your travel preferences. You may choose to begin and end the tour in Nairobi, or start in Nairobi and finish in Mombasa if you plan to enjoy a beach extension along the Kenyan Coast. Our experienced Tour Consultants at Magical Africa Safaris are always ready to guide you and help tailor your trip for the best possible wildlife holiday experience.
